Suggestion Bug report / complaint Subject Message Contact email (optional) Send message Frequently asked questions How does live library sharing work? Create a live workspace from a section note and share its invitation link. People with that link can view and edit notes for matching section paths; updates appear in connected views. How is my data protected? Private notes stay in this browser. Cloud support messages and shared notes are sent only when you choose those actions. A live-workspace invitation is a bearer link: anyone who has it can access that shared workspace. What can the study assistant do? It can summarize the current section, create review questions, and answer questions using the note text you choose to send. It does not browse your private library or send notes automatically. Which domains can I organize here? Create a structure for trading, welding, Quran study, art, learning, projects, or any topic that matters to you.
